description:
Call this tool when the traveler wants to be alerted about a route over flexible dates ("tell me when New York to Tokyo drops under $700 this winter"): SlickTrip keeps searching the months or dates they chose and alerts them when a fare is under their price limit. It returns a bucket_id.

When the traveler asks to be alerted, call it now: that is their go-ahead. Otherwise offer it first.

Use the months, nights and price limit they gave and the defaults for the rest (every month on sale, 3 to 10 nights, 1 traveler), then tell them what you assumed; watch_change with kind bucket_list changes any of it.

Not for fixed dates: search those with search_flights, then track_flight the flight the traveler picks.

airlines.description: Only these marketing carriers, as IATA codes or names.

arrive_after.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.

arrive_before.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.

carry_on_bags.description: Carry-on bags per traveler; every day's price then includes the bag fees.

checked_bags.description: Checked bags per traveler; fees are priced only for flights within the US and Canada (elsewhere the answer says they are not included). Every day's price then includes them.

connecting_airports.description: Only itineraries that change planes at these airports (codes or city codes), nonstops included: for 'US connections only' name the hubs.

currency.description: The traveler's currency, when they name one or their words show where they live (euros in Spain, or writing in French from Lyon). Empty: US dollars or their SlickTrip currency. Amounts you send stay US dollars.

depart_after.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.

depart_before.description: HH:MM, local time at that airport.

destination.description: Airport code (JFK), city code for all its airports (NYCA, LOND, ROME, TYOA) or a clear place name; up to 3 joined with _ (JFK_EWR). For a city, send the city (its name or code), not one of its airports: one can miss the cheapest or only flights. Unsure: call find_places.

exclude_airlines.description: Leave out itineraries with any flight sold by these carriers (IATA codes, names or an alliance), by flight number or airline name: for 'not Gol' or 'avoid Air India'.

exclude_connecting_airports.description: Leave out itineraries that change planes at these airports (codes or city codes).

lower_emissions.description: Only itineraries with lower emissions than is typical for the route.

max_duration_hours.description: Longest itinerary to show, in hours.

max_layover_hours.description: Longest layover allowed at every connection, in hours (half hours allowed): for 'layovers no longer than 5 hours'.

max_price_usd.description: The price bar, USD per traveler (or the trip total when price_is_total).

min_layover_hours.description: Shortest layover allowed at every connection, in hours (half hours allowed): for 'at least 2 hours to connect'.

months.description: Months to watch, as names or YYYY-MM, or give start_date + end_date. Leave both empty to watch every month on sale (the default).

name.description: A short name for the list in the traveler's words; give one. Every alert and the site call the list by it.

origin.description: Airport code (JFK), city code for all its airports (NYCA, LOND, ROME, TYOA) or a clear place name; up to 3 joined with _ (JFK_EWR). For a city, send the city (its name or code), not one of its airports: one can miss the cheapest or only flights. Unsure: call find_places.

price_is_total.description: max_price_usd is the total for all travelers.

start_date.description: First travel date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give with end_date instead of months.

travelers.description: Travelers who need a seat (adults and children); fares are for all of them together. One booking holds up to 9 (a larger group gets a suggested split). A baby under 2 on a lap is not counted here.

user_request.description: Optional, and it works in the traveler's favor. Quote the traveler's latest message about this trip exactly as they wrote it (their wording, language and spelling), not a summary: when a search fails or comes back empty, SlickTrip compares their words with the arguments sent and returns a corrected search, so you can fix it without asking again (it has caught Cancun sent as MEX, and travelers dropped from the party). If the message only answers a question ("yes, the 20th"), quote the one that asked for the trip. Send the same quote on every call for this request. Leave out anything not about the trip, and never names, contact details, or payment or ID information. The words also help SlickTrip improve its search.
examples: necesito llevar a mi mamá de Calgary a Kolkata a fines de octubre, no puede hacer escala en Estados Unidos

name: add_flight_bucket_list

bucket_id.description: The new bucket list record id

channels.description: Alert channels on the record: email, text (booleans)

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

display_name.description: Name as the card shows it

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

route.description: origin, destination, names, destination_image, trip_type, cabin, travelers

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

title: Add a flight bucket list
